senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. יָדָה) [to point out, select, love,]

units: <cite ref="Pesachim 87b:7">Pes. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שי׳ שחטא</he> when he was convinced that he had done wrong.
<cite ref="Pesachim 87b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>ואין אתה יוֹדֵעַ אם וכ׳</he> and thou knowest not whether &c.

<cite ref="Pesachim 87b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>יודע הקב״ה את ישראל וכ׳</he> the Lord knows that Israel cannot endure the cruel persecutions of Rome (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 529:5">Yalk. Hos. 529</cite>.

<cite ref="Shevuot 4b:1">Shebu. 4ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 5a:11">ib. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>ונעלם מבלל שי׳</he> it says, ‘and it escaped his memory’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 5:3">Lev. V, 3</cite>)—this proves that there was a time when he knew (the nature of his act, v. <cite ref="J00104"><he>יְדִיעָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Zevachim 115b:13">Zeb. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>דבר זה … ולא יְדָעוֹ וכ׳</he> this word (<cite ref="Exodus 29:43">Ex. XXIX, 43</cite>) the Lord had said to Moses, but he did not understand it, until the sons of Aaron died.
Ib. כיון שי׳ … יְדוּעֵי מקום הן when Aaron learned that his sons were the chosen of the Lord (Lev. X, 3); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. יָדוּעַ

senses.gloss: known, special, certain. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 6, ch. VIII חטא י׳ a known (discovered) sin, v. יְדִיעָה.
units: Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ טומאה יְדוּעָה (not ידוע) an ascertained levitical uncleanness, opp. ספק; a. fr.—בְּיָדוּעַ it is sure.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 20b:3">R. Hash. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>בי׳ שנראה וכ׳</he> the moon must have been visible &c.
<cite ref="Sukkah 49b:12">Succ. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>כל אדם … בי׳ שהוא וכ׳</he> a popular man (v. <cite ref="H01249"><he>חֵן</he></cite>) is, you may be sure, a God-fearing man; a. fr.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Yevamot 57a:3">Yeb. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>בלא יְדָעָהּ</he> when he never had connection with her.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:11">Esth. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>שלא יְדָעָהּ איש וכ׳</he> whom no man except her husband touched; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:2">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 4:1">Gen. IV, 1</cite>, reading <cite ref="J00107"><he>יִדַּע</he></cite> for homiletical purposes) <he>ה׳ דרך ארץ לכל</he> he showed to all the way of the land (propagation, v. <cite ref="D01096"><he>דֶּרֶךְ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 5:3">Ḥull. V, 3</cite> <he>צריך להוֹדִיעַ</he> must inform (the purchaser).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite> <he>לֵידַע להודיע ולהִוָּורַע</he> to learn, to proclaim and to be made to feel (be thoroughly convinced).
<cite ref="Shabbat 10b:5">Sabb. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>צריך להוֹדִיעוֹ</he> must inform him.
<cite ref="Shabbat 10b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>לך והוֹדִיעֵם</he> go and tell them.
<cite ref="Shabbat 10b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>הנותן … צריך לה׳ לאמו</he> he who gives bread to a child must inform his mother; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be informed, become conscious; to be made known.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 1:6">Shebu. I, 6</cite> <he>ה׳ ולא ה׳</he> whether he became conscious (of his transgression) or not. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, ch. XX, Par. 12 (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 4:23">Lev. IV, 23</cite>; <cite ref="Leviticus 4:28">28</cite>) <he>את ה׳ שלהם</he> when they become known; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 113b">B. Bath. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>הוֹדְעָה</he> Ms. M. (v. <cite ref="A03217"><he>אָרַע</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 3:3">Hor. III, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Shevuot 9b:3">Shebu. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>שסופו לִיוָּדַע</he> of which he is likely to be informed.
<cite ref="Chullin 9a:8">Ḥull. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיִוָּדַע לך</he>, v. <cite ref="H00556"><he>חֲזָקָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:5">Nidd. IX, 5</cite>, v. infra; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 25b:12">Bekh. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיִתְוַורַּע הטומאה</he> (Nidd. l. c. <he>עד שיודע לך וכ׳</he>) until he ascertains the exact place of uncleanness; <cite ref="Pesachim 10a:8">Pes. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שתִּיוָּדַע לך</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.). Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ <he>נתודע לו וכ׳</he> he found it out after sunset; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (v. מוֹדַע) to force one’s self upon the notice of, to pretend friendship for.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:10">Ab. I, 10</cite> <he>אל תִּתְוַדַּע לרשות</he> do not make thyself a partisan of the (foreign) government.
